findings.title: Container lacks a Linux capability it uses
findings.cause: container web exits on an operation that is not permitted: its securityContext drops ALL capabilities, and changing a file's owner needs CHOWN, which root too must hold; its log says: "chown: /var/cache/app: Operation not permitted"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container web's log (current run)
evidence.detail:
chown: /var/cache/app: Operation not permitted
chown: /var/cache/app: Operation not permitted

evidence.what: container web's securityContext drops ALL capabilities

findings.fix: Add CHOWN under securityContext.capabilities.add, keeping drop: [ALL], or change the image or its start script so it no longer needs it (ownership and modes can be set when the image is built, or by fsGroup for volumes).
